name: DeVries Fruit & Veggie Roadside Stand / The Friend-ly Farm
tagline: DeVries Fruit and Veggie Roadside Stand / The Friend
description: DeVries Fruit & Veggie Roadside Stand / The Friend-ly Farm is a working farm in 451 South 3rd Street, CO. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
